title: Motion design showreel (Canvas)
description: An abstract motion-design reel in a five-colour brand palette, in six designed beats with one focal point each: a dot grid ripples and springs into a disc; the disc morphs circle, squircle, triangle, star on springs with colour echoes and orbiting satellites, then irises open; word 1 rises letter by letter through a mask; a staggered diagonal stripe wipe cuts to circular kinetic type (word 2 round a rotating ring around a sprung disc); the disc irises into word 3, revealed two-tone by a sliding mask panel; shutters close and the name lands with an impact ring, three sprung shapes and a tracked kicker. Beats scale with the duration; any aspect ratio.

name.description: Studio, brand or designer name for the closing lockup

words.description: Three short words or phrases, one per beat (1-2 words each read best)

kicker.description: Small tracked line under the name (set in capitals; empty for none)

palette.description: Ground, ink and three brand colours (C1 carries word 1 and the impact, C2 the ring disc and word 3, C3 the echoes and the mask panel). Ink on every ground is chosen for 4.5:1 contrast

notes: Beats are designed at 15 s and scale with D (k = D / 15): dots 0-2.1 k; morph pops at 2.4, 3.0, 3.6 k and a pulse at 4.0 k; iris 4.1 k; word 1 from 4.6 k; stripe wipe from 6.5 k (covered at 6.92 k); ring and word 2 from about 7.0 k; ring iris 9.0 k; word 3 from 9.35 k with the mask sweep 9.9-11.25 k; shutters 11.4-11.72 k; name impact 12.2 k; kicker 12.6 k; hold to D. Works from about 10 s; at 15 s each word holds 1.6-2 s.
Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`. Uses the system's Inter when installed.
